verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a public, OpenAI-compatible REST API (api.fireworks.ai) covering chat completions, tool/function calling, structured outputs, batch, embeddings, and fine-tuning, with extensive docs and llms.txt index confirmed live. This is inherently machine/AI-drivable since it's OpenAI-compatible and well documented for programmatic use. Missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate paths 404) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
